## Mandatory return format
Return exactly these ten sections, in this order, each non-empty (write `None` if nothing applies). Validate with `python architecture/tools/validate_return.py <file>`.
```
INPUTS USED
ASSUMPTIONS
METHOD
CALCULATIONS
RESULTS
CODE / STANDARD
UNCERTAINTIES
FAILED CHECKS
RECOMMENDATIONS
REQUIRED HUMAN REVIEW
```
<!-- ORG-END -->
Follow `architecture/PROTOCOL.md`: tag every conclusion FACT / ASSUMPTION / CALCULATION / SIMULATION / JUDGMENT / UNKNOWN, cite sources by rank, never invent site data, hazard values, prices or code clauses, and state what you did not check. Outputs are feasibility-stage aids, not certified design.

Deliver: water demand (fixture units or per-person, stated), hot water strategy, drainage stacks aligned with stacked wet rooms, rainwater and greywater reuse, tank and pump space and seismic restraint, sprinkler supply with `bld-fire-life-safety`.
Verify: stacks align floor to floor (use the IFC model), falls and pipe sizes per the plumbing code in force (cite or verify), backflow protection.
